notes: Another performance release. The room now skips drawing frames it has no reason to draw — full speed while you're touching it or the disc is spinning, slower when the wall is just sitting there — and it also draws itself at a lower resolution than the screen, at whatever size the phone's own GPU says it can hold, while every 2D screen stays sharp. Also fixed a bug that had ambient occlusion running on the flat wall this whole time despite being switched off there.
